policies.flexible: Full refund up to 24 hours before the start. No refund after that.
policies.moderate: Full refund up to 72 hours before the start. 50% refund up to 24 hours before. No refund after that.
policies.strict: 50% refund up to 7 days before the start. No refund after that.

partners.name: Eko Nature Trails
partners.description: Small-group nature walks and wildlife trips around the Lekki peninsula, led by trained naturalists.

guides.name: Adaeze Nwankwo
guides.bio: Naturalist with nine years leading walks at the conservation centre.

guides.name: Samuel Ade
guides.bio: Birding specialist and former park ranger.

partners.name: Funmi Island Tours
partners.address: Tarzan Jetty, Maroko Road, Victoria Island, Lagos
partners.description: Boat trips to the beaches across Lagos Harbour, with life jackets, umbrellas and lunch.

guides.name: Funmi Ogunleye
guides.bio: Grew up on the harbour and has run boat trips since 2015.

partners.name: Badagry Roots Guides
partners.description: Heritage day trips to Badagry led by a local historian.

partners.name: Lekki Arts Hub
partners.description: Galleries, a sculpture garden and live music on Saturday nights.

tours.title: Lekki Conservation Centre
tours.description: Walk the longest canopy walkway in Africa, spot mona monkeys and crocodiles, and learn how the reserve protects Lagos wetlands with a naturalist guide.
tours.meetingPoint: Lekki Conservation Centre main gate, Km 19 Lekki–Epe Expressway
itinerary: Meet your guide at the main gate

tours.title: Lekki Lagoon Kayak at Sunrise
tours.description: Paddle the calm lagoon at first light past fishing villages and mangroves, then share breakfast on the shore.

tours.title: Omu Resort Wildlife Day
tours.description: A full day at a family wildlife park with a zoo, quad bikes and a pool.

tours.title: Tarkwa Bay Boat Trip
tours.description: Cross the harbour by speedboat to a sheltered beach for swimming and grilled fish, with life jackets and a beach umbrella waiting for you.
tours.meetingPoint: Tarzan Jetty, Maroko Road, Victoria Island

tours.title: Ilashe Beach Day
tours.description: A quieter beach west of Tarkwa with a private beach house for the day.
tours.meetingPoint: Tarzan Jetty, Maroko Road, Victoria Island
tours.reviewNote: Please add at least two photos of the beach house and the boat operator's passenger insurance before we publish this tour.

tours.title: Badagry Slave Route Day Trip
tours.description: A full day in Badagry: the Point of No Return, the Seriki Abass slave barracoon and the first storey building in Nigeria.
tours.meetingPoint: Cabo pickup point, Ozumba Mbadiwe Avenue, Victoria Island
